thread:
amanda: Hey team — saw a 2.3x tail latency spike on conv workloads w/ long contexts (~65k tokens) around 03:12 UTC. Noticed memory growth on the runtime host.
kai: Which pool/variant?
amanda: prod-gpu-pool-3, model: gptx-16k-quant, kernel set: auto (fp16 kernels) — routing shows many requests pinned to same worker.
devin: I pulled profiles. KV cache pager shows repeated small allocations and high fragmentation. Flamegraph attached: run `perf record -F 99 -g -- sleep 30` then `perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl | flamegraph.pl > kv-frag.svg`
amanda: snippet from pprof:
```
kv_cache_evict(): 34.2%
tinypage_alloc(): 18.4%
kv_reuse_check(): 12.1%
page_scan_worker(): 10.9%
writeback_swap(): 9.7%
```
yusuf: Is eviction FIFO or LRU? We changed default to fifo under high throughput months ago.
amanda: It should be LRU for that pool but config shows fifo for prod-gpu-pool-3 (my bad). FIFO seems to be reinsert-heavy with tinypage fragmentation causing lots of pager churn.
kai: Interesting — FIFO's reinserts are creating many short-lived chain nodes. Under long contexts we see very wide KV entries leading to partial evictions and reassignments.
devin: Also saw correctness guard trips: `kv_reuse_check` returning false for entries that had identical key but different slab_id due to tinypage split. Reuse predicate rejects them, causing cache misses and more load.
amanda: Steps to repro locally: run the long-context load generator `tools/bench/long_context_reuse.sh --clients 60 --ctx 65000` and use `--kv-config fifo --tinypage 64`.
yusuf: Could we try temporary mitigation: bump tinypage coalescing threshold to 128 and switch pool back to lru? Quick config diff:
```
- tinypage_threshold = 64
+ tinypage_threshold = 128
- eviction_policy = fifo
+ eviction_policy = lru
```
kai: I ran the bench with those changes in staging — tail latency dropped ~45% and page-scan counts reduced by ~72%.
devin: Agree on quick rollback + longer-term: add a "warmness" predictor in reuse_check that considers contiguous slab fragments as one logical entry (so reinserts don't break reuse).
amanda: Also propose adding a paged-alloc histogram to runtime metrics to detect fragmentation early.
yusuf: I'll open a follow-up issue with required configs + rollout plan. @devin @kai can you add repro data and flamegraphs to the ticket?
devin: On it. attaching perf tarball to ticket `TKT-6543`.
kai: +1. Re: correctness — we need a unit test that creates contrived splits and asserts reuse succeeds when keys match.
amanda: Thanks all, switching pool on prod in 10m window and monitoring. :eyes: 
pagerbot: Deploy scheduled: change/prod/kvs/policy 1778881210 by yusuf — watch windows: 10:00-10:30 UTC
yusuf: rolling now, will post results.
